question: Why did battery claims spike in APAC during Q3 2025 and which lot was responsible?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT year, month, count(*) as claims FROM fact_support_claims WHERE region_id = 'APAC' AND claim_type LIKE '%Battery%' GROUP BY year, month ORDER BY year, month;
expected_facts: Lot BP-2025-08 caused over 4,200 monthly claims in Q3 2025

question: What caused the revenue slump in EMEA retail stores during Q2 2025?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT month, sum(spend_usd) as mkt_spend FROM fact_marketing_spend WHERE region_id = 'EMEA' AND year = 2025 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
expected_facts: 55% marketing spend cut caused ~28% contraction in retail store revenue

question: What was the attach ratio of PearWatch Ultra 2 to PearPhone 16 Pro in AMER during Q4 2025 holiday promo?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT sum(case when product_id = 'PRD-WCH-ULT2' then units else 0 end) * 1.0 / sum(case when product_id = 'PRD-PHN-16P' then units else 0 end) as attach_ratio FROM fact_sales WHERE region_id = 'AMER' AND year = 2025 AND month IN (10, 11, 12);
expected_facts: Holiday attach ratio jumped to 0.372 compared to off-season 0.165

question: What caused the high return rate for PearBook Pro 16" in early 2025?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT month, count(*) as defect_returns FROM fact_returns WHERE product_id = 'PRD-NBK-16P' AND year = 2025 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
expected_facts: Firmware v14.2 timing controller defect caused return rate to reach 5.1%

question: What was the total net revenue for FY 2025 across all channels?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT sum(net_revenue) as total_net_revenue FROM fact_sales WHERE year = 2025;
expected_facts: Total net revenue aggregated across all transactions

question: Which product generated the highest gross revenue in 2025?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT product_id, sum(gross_revenue) as rev FROM fact_sales WHERE year = 2025 GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 1;
expected_facts: PearPhone 16 Pro is the flagship revenue driver

question: Compare online vs retail store net sales revenue in 2025.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT channel, sum(net_revenue) as channel_revenue FROM fact_sales WHERE year = 2025 GROUP BY channel;
expected_facts: Online and retail store channel breakdown

question: What is the breakdown of unit sales by product line in 2025?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.line, sum(s.units) as total_units FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_product p ON s.product_id = p.product_id WHERE s.year = 2025 GROUP BY p.line ORDER BY total_units DESC;
expected_facts: Phone line dominates total volume

question: What was the monthly net revenue trajectory in AMER during 2025?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT month, sum(net_revenue) as monthly_revenue FROM fact_sales WHERE region_id = 'AMER' AND year = 2025 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
expected_facts: Peak revenue occurs in November and December holiday season

question: What was the total discount amount conceded across all sales in 2025?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT sum(discount_amount) as total_discount FROM fact_sales WHERE year = 2025;
expected_facts: Discount amount is tracked and deducted from gross revenue

question: What are the top 3 cities by total retail sales volume?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT st.city, sum(s.units) as total_units FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_store st ON s.store_id = st.store_id GROUP BY st.city ORDER BY total_units DESC LIMIT 3;
expected_facts: Major metropolitan flagship stores drive top volume

question: What is the average transaction value per sale record in 2025?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT avg(net_revenue) as avg_order_val FROM fact_sales WHERE year = 2025;
expected_facts: Calculates average basket value

question: What percentage of total units were sold through carrier partner stores?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT sum(case when channel = 'Carrier' then units else 0 end) * 100.0 / sum(units) as carrier_pct FROM fact_sales WHERE year = 2025;
expected_facts: Carrier channel represents significant wholesale volume

question: How did Q4 revenue compare to Q3 revenue in 2025?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT case when month in (10,11,12) then 'Q4' else 'Q3' end as quarter, sum(net_revenue) as rev FROM fact_sales WHERE year = 2025 AND month >= 7 GROUP BY 1;
expected_facts: Q4 displays standard holiday lift over Q3

question: How many total warranty claims were filed in 2025 across all regions?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT count(*) as total_claims, sum(claim_cost_usd) as total_cost FROM fact_support_claims WHERE year = 2025;
expected_facts: Total claim volume and associated warranty remediation cost

question: Which product model incurred the largest total warranty repair cost in 2025?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT product_id, sum(claim_cost_usd) as total_claim_cost FROM fact_support_claims WHERE year = 2025 GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY total_claim_cost DESC LIMIT 1;
expected_facts: PearPhone 16 Pro incurred highest warranty expense due to battery recall

question: What is the breakdown of support claims by claim type in 2025?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT claim_type, count(*) as count FROM fact_support_claims WHERE year = 2025 GROUP BY claim_type ORDER BY count DESC;
expected_facts: Battery degradation and screen issues form the majority of claims

question: How many claims in EMEA were approved versus rejected in 2025?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT resolution_status, count(*) as count FROM fact_support_claims WHERE region_id = 'EMEA' AND year = 2025 GROUP BY resolution_status;
expected_facts: Majority of legitimate hardware claims receive approved replacement or repair

question: What is the average turnaround resolution time in days for claims on PearBuds Pro?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT avg(resolution_time_days) as avg_turnaround FROM fact_support_claims WHERE product_id = 'PRD-AUD-PRO2' AND year = 2025;
expected_facts: Average swap turnaround is under 3 days

question: What was the month-over-month trend in claim costs in APAC during 2025?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT month, sum(claim_cost_usd) as monthly_cost FROM fact_support_claims WHERE region_id = 'APAC' AND year = 2025 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
expected_facts: Massive spike visible in July, August, and September 2025

question: What was the total marketing spend by channel in 2025?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT campaign_type, sum(spend_usd) as total_spend FROM fact_marketing_spend WHERE year = 2025 GROUP BY campaign_type ORDER BY total_spend DESC;
expected_facts: Performance digital and brand awareness lead marketing expenditure

question: How did marketing spend in EMEA compare between Q1 and Q2 2025?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT case when month in (1,2,3) then 'Q1' else 'Q2' end as quarter, sum(spend_usd) as spend FROM fact_marketing_spend WHERE region_id = 'EMEA' AND year = 2025 AND month <= 6 GROUP BY 1;
expected_facts: Q2 spend drops by more than 50% relative to Q1

question: Which region had the largest marketing investment in 2025?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT region_id, sum(spend_usd) as total_spend FROM fact_marketing_spend WHERE year = 2025 GROUP BY region_id ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 1;
expected_facts: AMER receives the primary share of global marketing capital

question: What was the monthly digital advertising spend in APAC during 2025?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT month, sum(spend_usd) as digital_spend FROM fact_marketing_spend WHERE region_id = 'APAC' AND campaign_type = 'Digital Performance' AND year = 2025 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
expected_facts: Digital spend trend shows seasonal pacing across quarters

question: What was the global return rate across all hardware products in 2025?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT (SELECT sum(units) FROM fact_returns WHERE year = 2025) * 100.0 / (SELECT sum(units) FROM fact_sales WHERE year = 2025) as return_rate;
expected_facts: Average baseline hardware return rate is between 1.8% and 2.4%

question: What were the primary return reasons for PearBook Pro 16" in Q1 2025?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT return_reason, count(*) as count FROM fact_returns WHERE product_id = 'PRD-NBK-16P' AND year = 2025 AND month <= 3 GROUP BY return_reason ORDER BY count DESC;
expected_facts: Hardware defects regarding display timing accounted for majority of returns

question: What was the total refund amount processed for returns in 2025?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT sum(refund_amount) as total_refunds FROM fact_returns WHERE year = 2025;
expected_facts: Total customer refunds processed by retail and online operations

question: What proportion of returned items were restored to refurbished inventory?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT sum(case when return_status = 'Restocked/Refurbished' then 1 else 0 end) * 100.0 / count(*) as refurb_pct FROM fact_returns WHERE year = 2025;
expected_facts: Over 60% of open-box returns pass inspection for certified refurbished sale

question: What is the distribution of active customers across membership tiers?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_tier, count(*) as member_count FROM dim_customer GROUP BY customer_tier ORDER BY member_count DESC;
expected_facts: Customer base partitioned across Standard, Plus, and Pro tiers

question: Which customer region has the largest total registered account base?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT region_id, count(*) as customer_count FROM dim_customer GROUP BY region_id ORDER BY customer_count DESC;
expected_facts: AMER leads total registered customer count

question: Show customer list with contact email and phone number for top spenders.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_id, email, phone FROM dim_customer LIMIT 5;

question: Show customer contact details for audit review as admin.

question: What was the recognized GAAP net revenue and deferred services revenue for FY 2025?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT sum(recognized_net_revenue) as recognized_rev, sum(deferred_services_revenue) as deferred_rev FROM fact_finance_revenue WHERE fiscal_year = 2025;
expected_facts: Finance ledger records both recognized hardware and amortized service subscriptions
